page.layout: Running head at top centre. One page of text: a block of verse at the top, a centred title block in the middle, then a second block of verse. No margin notes, no catchword.

main_text.l: eque tibique paresisto cognomine signans,
Quos fugerent monuit scilicet ipse suos,
Semper vel in te uno monstrans qualis foret illa
Iesu ementito nomine tecta cohors,
Commune eiurans qua Christi ex nomine nomen,
Illequod unus habet vendicat ipsa sibi.
At tu vere tuos o nunc miseratus
Iesu, Fac tibi ne pereant quos pater ipse dedit,
Immo perde malos, ut vero verus Iesu
Debitus a cunctis sic tribuatur honos.
nPapæ ZACHARIÆ epistolam,
ad BONIFACIVM Episcopum,
Germaniæ Septentrionali destinatum.
Ens inculta diu Arctoa Germana sub ora,
Se pauisse feris barbara fertur equis:
Quae Christum amplecti, posita feritate, parata,
Baptismi sacras quum rogitaret aquas:
Baptizentur, ait super illis Papa rogatus:
Parcere, ut immundis sed iubeantur equis.
Nempe sibi metuens, negens hac effera forte,
Concessis asinos addere vellet equis.

page.notes: Scan is faded at the left edge of the top verse lines; the first word of line 3 ("Semper") and the first letter of "Baptizentur" are partly lost and read with doubt. The "n" before "Papæ" may be a stray mark. Faint foxing and speckles elsewhere, not transcribed.
